title: Singular Hochschild complex and Cartan matrix
summary: If A is a symmetric algebra, then Hochschild homology of the dg enhancement of the singularity category of A agrees with singular Hochschild homology of A. For a basic finite dimensional k algebra A, the Cartan matrix of A is symmetric if and only if the k dual of the mixed complex of the dg enhancement of its singularity category is isomorphic to its shift by -1. We provide two counterexamples to show that neither result holds for general Frobenius algebras.
